description: Build the shopper's whole-kitchen (or bath) Hardware Plan: one line per zone (doors, drawers by width, island, tall, appliance panels) with the exact Knobs.co product, finish, size, count and list price, totals, the pieces that qualify as samples, and what is still unconfirmed. Use it once the shopper has given counts, drilling (existing holes or fresh), finish, style and a budget; include products they liked from search_catalog as candidates. The plan is saved for 90 days at the returned plan_url, where the shopper can see it and add its samples or the whole plan to their cart. To change counts, finish or products, call build_plan again with the corrected answers; for Kayla's review, request_consultation with the plan_url. No email or account needed. Costs real money on our side, so call it once per shopper, after the facts are gathered.

answers.description: What the shopper has told the agent about the project. Every field is optional, but the plan needs at least the counts, the drilling situation and the finish.

appliance_panels.description: panel-front appliances (dishwasher, refrigerator) that get a pull

budget_tier.description: per piece, in their words ("under $8", "$10–20", "no limit")

doors.description: cabinet doors that get a knob or pull (not drawers, not tall/pantry doors)

drilling.description: existing = holes already drilled (give existing_c2c_text); fresh = new cabinets or new holes

existing_c2c_text.description: the existing hole spacing exactly as the shopper said it ("3 inches", "96 mm"); "" if none

finish.description: the finish they want (matte black, satin nickel, brushed brass…)

knobs_vs_pulls.description: "all pulls", "knobs on doors, pulls on drawers", "all knobs", or what they said

notes.description: anything else that matters: island, brands liked or disliked, must-match items, measurements

scope.description: the project in a few words ("kitchen remodel, 28 doors and 14 drawers", "two bath vanities")

timing.description: when they need the hardware, in their words ("this week", "cabinets arrive in March", "no rush")

trade.description: true for a designer, contractor or cabinet shop

candidates.description: products the shopper liked or the agent found with search_catalog (handle + variant_id in the right finish), optionally with the zone and count they are for

count.description: how many pieces this candidate covers, if known

handle.description: the product handle from search_catalog or get_product

variant_id.description: numeric Shopify variant id of the finish they want (from get_product); omit to let the plan pick the finish

summary.description: two to six sentences of what the shopper told you, in their words where possible (shown to Kayla if they later ask for a review)

name: build_plan
title: Build a Hardware Plan (Knobs.co)
